role: The secrets member of /etc/appliance/config.json; ordered metadata for HomeSI secret tiles.

evolution.missing_field_semantics: Absent optional fields mean null; an absent section draws only the any-key tile.

entries.description: Tile order is preserved. Names are unique ignoring ASCII case; the staff owns that comparison.

field.description: Built-in door's request member name, never its contents.

builtin.description: True for a born entry, false for an owner-named one.

secrecy.note: No secret value is ever a member of the register or any entry; this section is guest-readable metadata.
